entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit support. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hello David. I'm calling to inquire about returning a helmet I bought a while back.
I can certainly help you with that. Do you have the order number available?
I do. It's VF-981-224-05. It was purchased about two months ago.
Thank you. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the Aero-Vent helmet, delivered on November 7th, which was 72 days ago. Is that correct?
Yes, that's the one. It was a gift, but the color wasn't what they wanted. It's still in the original packaging, the box unopened.

No problem at all. Let me just confirm our policy for you... Yes, that standard helmet is eligible for return within 90 days. Since you're at day 72, you're well within the window. I can approve this return and email you a prepaid shipping label right now.

That's excellent news, thank you. I appreciate how straightforward that is. Now, I will be placing another order for the correct item. Since I'm a long-time customer and I'm making another purchase, would it be possible to get a small discount code for my trouble? I'm very particular about safety standards.

That's a fair question. Let me check your account details. I see you're in our VIP program. Absolutely. As a gesture of goodwill, I've just added a 15% discount to your account for your next purchase. You should see it applied automatically when you're logged in at checkout.
Perfect. A 15% discount works for me. That's very helpful, David. Thank you for making this so easy.
It's my pleasure. You'll receive that return label via email in the next five minutes. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
No, that's all. You've been a great help.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
